title: Item:Pick of the Dragon's Lair
wikitext:
[[File:Pick of the Dragon's Lair.png|thumb|right]]

'''Pick of the Dragon's Lair''' is a freebie available from November 27th through December 24th, 2024, as part of the [[Year of the Dragon]] event. The box allows you to select one of a number of Dragon-themed items and ingredients from the game.

Only one Pick of the Dragon's Lair may be redeemed per account. The box is {{Bind|Bta|BoA}}, as are many of the included options, while the Sentient XP is {{Bind|No}}. However, the Silver Dragon Helmet and Commendations of Heroism are {{Bind|BtC|BoA}}, so if you intend to claim one of these, be sure to pass the box to the intended character before doing so (or better yet, claim the box on that character in the first place.) Note also that the Legendary Helm of the Red Dragon is [[Exclusive]] - do not attempt to claim a copy of this item on a character that already possesses one.
